items.source: A WebSocketHandler must compose the inbound and outbound streams into a unified flow and return a Mono<Void> that reflects the completion of that flow. That means there is no need to check if the connection is open, since Reactive Streams signals will terminate activity. The inbound stream receives a completion/error signal, and the outbound stream receives a cancellation signal.
items.translation: `WebSocketHandler` 必须将入站和出站流组合成统一的流程，并返回一个反映该流程完成的 `Mono<Void>`。这意味着无需检查连接是否打开，因为 Reactive Streams 信号会终止活动。入站流接收完成/错误信号，而出站流接收取消信号。

items.source: On the server side, WebSocketHandler is mapped to requests with SimpleUrlHandlerMapping and WebSocketHandlerAdapter.
items.translation: 在服务器端，WebSocketHandler 通过 SimpleUrlHandlerMapping 和 WebSocketHandlerAdapter 映射到请求。

items.source: On the client side, WebSocketHandler is passed into the WebSocketClient execute method.
items.translation: 在客户端，WebSocketHandler 被传入 WebSocketClient 的 execute 方法。

items.source:
indicates when application handling of the session is complete,
which should reflect the completion of the inbound message stream
(i.e. connection closing) and possibly the completion of the outbound
message stream and the writing of messages
items.translation: 指示应用程序对会话的处理已完成，这应反映入站消息流的完成（即连接关闭），以及出站消息流和消息写入的完成。
